scripts.dev: npm run tokens && npm run dev -w @wizardchat/web
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run core:web && npm run build -w @wizardchat/web
scripts.desktop: npm run tokens && npm run dev -w @wizardchat/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run tokens && npm run build -w @wizardchat/desktop
scripts.desktop:release: npm run tokens && npm run build:release -w @wizardchat/desktop
scripts.ios: npm run assets && npm run ios:core && cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && open WizardChat.xcodeproj
scripts.ios:build: npm run assets && apps/ios/scripts/build-core.sh && cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project WizardChat.xcodeproj -scheme WizardChat -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates build
scripts.ios:release: npm run assets && apps/ios/scripts/build-core.sh && cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && open WizardChat.xcodeproj
scripts.android: npm run assets && npm run android:core && npm run android:install
scripts.android:build: npm run assets && apps/android/scripts/build-core.sh && cd apps/android && ./gradlew :app:assembleGplayRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run assets && apps/android/scripts/build-core.sh && cd apps/android && ./gradlew :app:bundleGplayRelease
scripts.core:web: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name wizardchat_core
scripts.core:web:dev: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --dev --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name wizardchat_core
scripts.core:types: cargo run -q -p wizardchat-core --features typegen --example typegen && prettier --write apps/web/src/core/rpc/api.gen.ts > /dev/null
scripts.assets: npm run tokens && npm run i18n && npm run emoji && npm run icons
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run i18n && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p wizardchat-core -p wizardchat-core-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
